$description: W3C DTCG 2025.10 skeleton the Designer fills per-app. Three tiers: primitive → semantic → component. $extensions carry per-platform vendor metadata so transform_tokens emits the right native themer value (iOS Liquid Glass / Android M3 Expressive / Web shadcn). Copy this, replace the <…> values, delete groups you don't use. See references/tokens.md for the closed token-name vocabulary.

color.$description: Color tier. Primitive tonal ramp → semantic roles → component bindings. Every semantic token MUST resolve to a primitive in this file (no dangling refs).

brand.$description: The seed's HCT tonal ramp (tone stops 0–100). Generated by scripts/palette.py from the brand seed, or curated by hand for a supplied palette.

status-bar-bg.$description: MANDATORY if any screen is dark — the reactive status-bar overlay reads this. Omit only for all-light apps.

fg.$description: Semantic foreground roles. Pair with bg.* and verify APCA Lc≥75 body / Lc≥90 small.

typography.$description: Type tier. display ≠ body (see anti-slop: no Inter/Roboto/system as display).

radius.$description: Corner radius tier. The shadcn --radius alias maps here; M3 expressiveShape maps to a family.

space.$description: Spacing tier. space.target = 44 (Apple HIG / WCAG 2.5.5 hit target).

shadow.$description: Elevation tier. Used sparingly — anti-slop prefers color-block-over-shadow.

motion.$description: LEAN — only the 3 rise-in timing tokens ride the Token layer. Do NOT add a GSAP/anime/motion-* tree (the crew's closed enum + motion.dart + device gates win; see references/motion.md). Optional: omit the whole group if the design animates no entrance (kRiseMs=0 is honest). If present, all three are required (a partial set is a freeze-gate error).

duration.$description: → kRiseMs. Captured from the design's CSS entrance animation-delay. A miss surfaces as 0 (NO animation), never an Atlet fallback.

dy.$description: → kRiseDy. The captured translateY rise distance.
